profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker CCC and CIK 0001818201. The website listed for the company is calgoncarbon.com.

The website text describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon leader in air and water purification. It highlights FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon with over 40 years of success in applications such as TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial arenas. The site states FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The record lists no products, cases, or MCP servers. It indicates 374 law exposure entries in Illinois.
